issues.jp_before: 雨[あめ]{が/の|ga-sub-clause}降[ふ]っていない{あいだに|aida-ni}、犬[いぬ]{を|o-object}散歩[さんぽ]させましょう。
issues.problem: 降っていないあいだに is an unnatural way to say 'during a dry spell'; natives say 雨がやんでいるあいだに.
issues.action: Rewrote clause to 雨がやんでいるあいだに; English adjusted to 'while the rain has let up'.

issues.jp_before: 弟[おとうと]{が/の|ga-sub-clause}風邪[かぜ]{で|de-cause}休[やす]んでいる{あいだ|aida-ni}ずっと、母[はは]{が|ga-subject}そばにいました。
issues.problem: The location particle に in そばに was not marked as a slot.

issues.jp_before: 夜[よる]{の|no-possessive}{あいだ|aida-ni}ずっと、犬[いぬ]{が|ga-subject}鳴[な]いていました。
issues.problem: English says 'barking'; for a dog barking the standard verb is 吠える, while 鳴く is a generic animal cry.
issues.action: Changed 鳴いて to 吠[ほ]えて; lv 4 to 3.

issues.jp_before: 練習[れんしゅう]している{うちに|uchi-ni}、難[むずか]しい曲[きょく]{が|potential-ga}弾[ひ]けるようになりました。
issues.problem: With a potential verb, を is just as natural as が (曲を弾けるようになる), but it was not listed as an alternative.

issues.jp_before: 夜[よる]{が|ga-sub-clause}明[あ]けない{うちに|uchi-ni}、家[いえ]{を|o-departure}出[で]ました。
issues.problem: Wrong furigana: in 夜が明ける, 夜 is read よ, not よる. The subordinate-clause の alternative was also missing (夜の明けないうちに).
issues.action: Reading changed to 夜[よ]; slot changed to {が/の|ga-sub-clause}.

issues.jp_before: 道[みち]{が|ga-sub-clause}込[こ]まない{うちに|uchi-ni}、早[はや]く出発[しゅっぱつ]しましょう。
issues.problem: 道が混む is the standard spelling for congestion, and the subordinate-clause の alternative was missing.
issues.action: Changed 込 to 混[こ]; slot changed to {が/の|ga-sub-clause}.
